Our Story

A neighborhood
café

“An espresso, a conversation,
a home since 1979.”

In the heart of Montreal's Little Italy, Caffè San Simeon is more than a café — it's a gathering place and a family tradition carried on since 1979.

Every espresso is prepared with the same artisan care as day one. Here, time stands still.
